digest.component_or_area: binding-state repository delegation and selective tickets-branch publication
propositions: Repository checkpoints must never publish independently; only reconcile_helpers.py may trigger selective publication of the five allowlisted bridge-state files.
Unchanged passes must create no commit, and GET rotation and retired-first publication semantics must remain intact through the S1 facade.

Repository versus publication ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, rollback semantics, and explicit no-journal/no-format-migration decisions must be documented in ADR 0099 with subsystem-scoped sole-ownership exemptions for CLI id resolution and GHA commit-back.
Selective publication must stage exactly the five allowlisted files; unrelated files and non-allowlisted bridge-state files must neither be published nor destroyed.
The existing held-out selective-publication and binding-state regression suites must pass unchanged after removing superseded facade persistence branches.
